audit: Mx5 county-median leave-one-observed-donor-tract-out stability; provided-data-only sensitivity audit

method.population: Each original county-imputed GEOID is held fixed as a recipient; for each originally observed donor in its region-local COUNTYFP, remove that donor once and recompute the median of the remaining original observed donor values. Imputed values never donate.
method.metric: Absolute difference between the original county median and recomputed median for each recipient × donor-deletion scenario; global p95/max are over all such scenarios. Report per-recipient maximum over its county's donor deletions.
method.undefined_and_observed: Only the 1,011 source county-imputed recipient IDs are measured. Original observed values, undefined values, exact official GEOIDs, and county-imputed tier assignment are not changed; regional-tier rows are not donors or recipients.
method.median: NumPy median of the finite original observed donor Mx5 shares; no labels or refitting.

interpretation: County medians pass the registered global stability test (p95=0; minimum remaining donors=4); 19 recipients nevertheless have a per-recipient maximum shift above 0.10 and are flagged as local sensitivity outliers. Retain this diagnostic separately without changing frozen Mx5.
